data.one_liner: HTML rich text editor for Android, iOS, and Web built with Quill JS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WYSIWYG rich text editor widget and toolbar for Flutter applications across Android, iOS, and Web. Allows getting and setting content in both HTML and Delta formats, embedding media, and customizing the toolbar.
use_when: You need an HTML rich text editor supporting Android, iOS, and Web
You want to use Quill.js within a Flutter application
You need to retrieve or set content in HTML or Delta formats
avoid_when: You only need a simple plain text input field
You are targeting environments where WebViews are not supported
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms
Bundles Quill JS and CSS files for offline mode support
Includes a customizable toolbar with support for custom buttons and specific configurations
weaknesses: Relies on WebViews underneath for rendering the editor
Limited custom font-size and color picker expansion out of the box (marked as TODOs)
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up QuillHtmlEditor and QuillEditorController widgets.
